about: What debriefs and exit accounts have cost, measured from the usage annotations of every run on file that debriefed a seat in the present way, and from the experiments' records of calls (scripts/debrief-costs.ts; the table is in docs/behaviour/debrief.md). microusd is the figure used: the largest measured (a shortfall is costlier than a surplus, which is simply not spent); a debrief call measured at the old answer limit (900 tokens, until 2026-11-08) is counted as if it had run on to the present one, at the model's output price. The run multiplies it by margin_percent (a whole number, per cent). tokens: the costliest seat's, by which a model with no entry is priced (the floor: the most any measured seat took in tokens, at that model's price, times margin_percent; where no entry has tokens, the greater of the old reckoning at its price and the largest figure here). Add a model by measuring it, not by editing a figure.
